# spotlight_line (Resource)

A line: the stations a team's tasks move along, in order, and how they move. Import it as `<workspace id>/<team key>/<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spotlight_line" "core_delivery" {
  team_id = spotlight_team.core.id
  key     = "delivery"
  name    = "Delivery"
  role    = "delivery"
  runners = ["vpc-internal"]

  repository {
    name  = "acme/api"
    image = "ghcr.io/acme/api-runner:main"
    setup = "npm ci"
  }

  station {
    key       = "backlog"
    name      = "Backlog"
    kind      = "backlog"
    passes_to = ["implementation"]
  }

  station {
    key       = "implementation"
    name      = "Implementation"
    harness   = "claude-code"
    profile   = "careful"
    prompt    = file("${path.module}/prompts/core/delivery/implementation.md")
    check     = "npm test"
    tools     = ["linear.comment"]
    skills    = ["grafana"]
    runners   = ["gpu"]
    passes_to = ["code-review"]

    judge {
      rubric = file("${path.module}/judges/core/delivery/implementation.md")
      claims = [
        "The change touches only the files the task names.",
        "Every new function has a test.",
      ]
      pass_threshold = 0.5
      sample         = 0.2
      min_agreement  = 0.6
    }

    alert {
      measure  = "sent_back_rate"
      rises_by = 0.2
      over     = 20
    }

    alert {
      measure = "cost_per_run"
      above   = 5
      over    = 10
    }

    alert {
      measure  = "accepted_rate"
      falls_by = 0.1
      over     = 20
    }

    alert {
      measure = "merged_rate"
      below   = 0.4
      over    = 20
    }

    search {
      ceiling    = 20
      iterations = 4
      objective  = "cost"

      agent {
        harness = "claude-code"
        effort  = "high"
      }
    }
  }

  station {
    key       = "code-review"
    name      = "Code review"
    harness   = "claude-code"
    prompt    = "Review the change."
    passes_to = ["implementation"]
    ends      = true
  }

  station {
    key  = "completed"
    name = "Completed"
    kind = "completed"
  }

  reaction {
    happening = "github.checks.failed"
    from      = "implementation"
    to        = "implementation"
  }

  replay_check {
    max_regressions = 0
    ceiling         = 10
    currency        = "USD"
    min_gain        = 0.05
  }

  search {
    monthly_ceiling = 100
    currency        = "USD"
    ceiling         = 10
    period          = "7d"
    on_alert        = true
    cooldown        = "3d"
  }

  source {
    repository = "acme/platform"
    path       = "teams/core/delivery.tf"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Names the line within its team. It is immutable, so changing it replaces the line.
- `name` (String) What the line is called.
- `team_id` (String) The team the line belongs to. Changing it replaces the line.

### Optional

- `reaction` (Block Set) Moves a task when something happens, as when a pull request's checks fail. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--reaction))
- `replay_check` (Block, Optional) When a planned change to the line passes `spotlight replay check`, which replays the changed station's replay set under the change and compares it with the live config. `spotlight replay check` checks no change to a line without one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--replay_check))
- `repository` (Block Set) A repository the line works on. Spotlight stores them sorted by name, so they are a set. The repositories of a line name at most one `image`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository))
- `reviews` (Block, Optional) Which pull requests the line reviews, for a line whose role is `review`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--reviews))
- `role` (String) The role the line plays for its team, as in `delivery` or `review`. A role names one line.
- `runners` (Set of String) Where the line's work runs: the labels of a runner pool or trust, any of which a runner must answer to. A station's own `runners` replace it. Anywhere when left out.
- `search` (Block, Optional) How Spotlight searches for better configs of the line's work stations on its own, and how much it may spend. Every work station is searched when left out. A station's own `search` changes it for that station. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--search))
- `source` (Block, Optional) Where the line's Terraform lives, which Spotlight opens pull requests against when it finds a better station config. A source sets `repository` and `path`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--source))
- `station` (Block List) A station along the line, in order. A line has at least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--station))

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the resource within its workspace, as in `core/delivery`.
- `id` (String) Issued by Spotlight when the line is created, and never changed.
- `version` (Number) Rises with every change to the line; each write sends it back so a change made since is not overwritten.

<a id="nestedblock--reaction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reaction`

Required:

- `happening` (String) What happens, named source first, as in `github.checks.failed`.
- `to` (String) The station the task moves to, by key.

Optional:

- `from` (String) The station the task must be at, by key; any station when left out.


<a id="nestedblock--replay_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replay_check`

Optional:

- `ceiling` (Number) The most one check's replay may spend, in `currency`, above 0 and at most 1,000. 10 when left out.
- `currency` (String) The three-letter currency the ceiling is counted in, in upper case, as in `EUR`. `USD` when left out.
- `max_regressions` (Number) How many tasks a planned change may regress on and still pass, a whole number from 0. 0 when left out.
- `min_gain` (Number) The smallest change in success rate worth acting on, above 0 and at most 1. Gains smaller than this, or inside the replays' confidence interval, read as within noise. 0.05 when left out.


<a id="nestedblock--repository"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repository`

Required:

- `name` (String) The repository, named `owner/name`.

Optional:

- `image` (String) The runner image every station of this line runs in, built FROM `ghcr.io/usespotlightai/spotlight-runner`; unset runs on the host's default image.
- `setup` (String) Runs in the checkout as the agent before each run's agent starts, and before a change stack check wherever a layer changes a lockfile. Every repository says it when a station has a `check` and `diffs`. A shell command or script of one or more lines, at most 65536 characters.


<a id="nestedblock--reviews"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reviews`

Optional:

- `label` (String) The pull request label that requests a review, whatever `start` says. Matched without regard to case. GitHub labels are at most 50 characters.
- `mention` (String) The handle that requests a review.
- `skip` (Block, Optional) Pull requests not to review. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--reviews--skip))
- `start` (String) `opened`, to review every pull request as it opens, or `mentioned`, to review one when Spotlight is mentioned on it.

<a id="nestedblock--reviews--skip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reviews.skip`

Optional:

- `authors` (Set of String) Skip pull requests by these GitHub logins, in lower case, as in `dependabot[bot]`. Spotlight stores them sorted and each once, so they are a set.
- `drafts` (Boolean) Skip draft pull requests.
- `spotlight` (Boolean) Skip pull requests Spotlight opened.



<a id="nestedblock--search"></a>
### Nested Schema for `search`

Optional:

- `ceiling` (Number) The most one search may spend, in `currency`, above 0 and at most `monthly_ceiling` and 1,000. 10 when left out.
- `cooldown` (String) The shortest time between two automatic searches of a station, as in `12h` or `3d`, from 1h to 365d, and at most `period`. `3d` when left out.
- `currency` (String) The three-letter currency the ceilings are counted in, in upper case, as in `EUR`. `USD` when left out.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Spotlight searches the line's work stations on its own. `true` when left out.
- `monthly_ceiling` (Number) The most all automatic searches of the line may spend in one calendar month, in `currency`, above 0. 50 when left out.
- `on_alert` (Boolean) Whether an alert that goes off on a station starts a search. `true` when left out.
- `period` (String) The longest time between two scheduled searches of a station, as in `12h` or `7d`, from 1h to 365d. `7d` when left out.


<a id="nestedblock--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Optional:

- `path` (String) The Terraform file in it that contains the line, from the repository root, as in `teams/core/delivery.tf`.
- `repository` (String) The GitHub repository that contains the line's Terraform, named `owner/name`.


<a id="nestedblock--station"></a>
### Nested Schema for `station`

Required:

- `key` (String) Names the station within the line.
- `name` (String) What the station is called on the board.

Optional:

- `alert` (Block List) Warns when a measure of the station's runs moves past a threshold. An alert sets exactly one of `rises_by`, `above`, `falls_by` and `below`. For a rate, amounts are shares from 0 to 1, so 0.2 is 20 percentage points; for `cost_per_run`, they are amounts in the workspace's currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--station--alert))
- `check` (String) A command that must pass before a task moves on, as in `npm test`. A shell command or script of one or more lines, at most 65536 characters.
- `color` (String) A six digit hex colour, as in `#6d78d5`. Spotlight picks one when it is left out.
- `decisions` (Boolean) Whether the station records the agent's decisions for review.
- `description` (String) What the station is for.
- `diffs` (Boolean) Whether Spotlight generates a change stack from the diff of each run of the station.
- `effort` (String) How hard the agent thinks: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`.
- `ends` (Boolean) Whether a task that arrives at the station is finished.
- `harness` (String) The agent harness that works tasks here, as in `claude-code`.
- `judge` (Block, Optional) Scores the station's runs against a rubric or checkable claims, for Insights. A judge sets `sample`, `min_agreement` and at least one of `rubric` and `claims`. No run is judged when left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--station--judge))
- `kind` (String) `backlog`, `work` or `completed`.
- `memories` (Boolean) Whether the station drafts proposed team memories from each run it completes, for people to approve.
- `model` (String) The model the harness uses.
- `passes_to` (Set of String) The stations a task here may move on to, by key.
- `profile` (String) The harness profile the station's agent runs with, by key, as in `careful`.
- `prompt` (String) The instructions for the agent, usually read with `file()`.
- `runners` (Set of String) Where the station's work runs, in place of the line's `runners`: the labels of a runner pool or trust, any of which a runner must answer to. The line's apply when left out.
- `search` (Block, Optional) How Spotlight searches for a better config of this work station on its own, in place of the line's `search`. What it leaves out comes from the line's `search`. When `agent`, `iterations`, `repeats` or `objective` is left out, Spotlight picks it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--station--search))
- `skills` (List of String) The skills the station enables for its agent, by key.
- `tools` (List of String) The tools the station enables for its agent, as in `linear.comment`.

<a id="nestedblock--station--alert"></a>
### Nested Schema for `station.alert`

Required:

- `measure` (String) What is watched: `sent_back_rate`, `accepted_rate`, `checks_failed_rate`, `failed_rate`, `merged_rate`, `cost_per_run`.
- `over` (Number) How many runs are compared, at least 1.

Optional:

- `above` (Number) Alerts when the measure across the last `over` runs is higher than this. For a rate, a share from 0 to 1; for `cost_per_run`, an amount of 0 or more.
- `below` (Number) Alerts when the measure across the last `over` runs is lower than this. For a rate, a share from 0 to 1; for `cost_per_run`, an amount of 0 or more.
- `falls_by` (Number) Alerts when the measure over the last `over` runs is this much lower than over the `over` runs before. For a rate, a share above 0 and at most 1; for `cost_per_run`, an amount above 0.
- `rises_by` (Number) Alerts when the measure over the last `over` runs is this much higher than over the `over` runs before. For a rate, a share above 0 and at most 1; for `cost_per_run`, an amount above 0.


<a id="nestedblock--station--judge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `station.judge`

Optional:

- `claims` (List of String) Checkable claims the judge answers yes or no about each change, from 1 to 20, each at most 500 characters. A change passes when the share of claims met is at least `pass_threshold`.
- `min_agreement` (Number) How often the judge must agree with people, from 0 to 1, before Insights shows its scores.
- `pass_threshold` (Number) Share of claims a change must meet to pass, from 0 to 1, set only with `claims`. 1 means every claim. 1 when left out.
- `rubric` (String) What a good run looks like, at most 20,000 characters, usually read with `file()`, as in `file("judges/implement.md")`. Optional when `claims` is set.
- `sample` (Number) The share of runs judged, from 0 to 1.


<a id="nestedblock--station--search"></a>
### Nested Schema for `station.search`

Optional:

- `agent` (Block, Optional) The agent that proposes candidate configs. An agent sets `harness`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--station--search--agent))
- `ceiling` (Number) The most one search of this station may spend, in the line's `currency`, above 0 and at most the line's `monthly_ceiling` and 1,000.
- `cooldown` (String) The shortest time between two automatic searches of this station, as in `12h` or `3d`, from 1h to 365d.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Spotlight searches this station on its own.
- `iterations` (Number) How many iterations one search runs, from 1 to 10.
- `objective` (String) What a search improves: `success` or `cost`. The station's health decides when left out.
- `on_alert` (Boolean) Whether an alert that goes off on this station starts a search.
- `period` (String) The longest time between two scheduled searches of this station, as in `12h` or `7d`, from 1h to 365d.
- `repeats` (Number) How many times a search replays each task, from 1 to 5.

<a id="nestedblock--station--search--agent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `station.search.agent`

Optional:

- `effort` (String) How hard the agent thinks: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`.
- `harness` (String) The agent harness, as in `claude-code`.
- `model` (String) The model the harness uses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_line.core_delivery
  identity = {
    id = "3f8a1c2e-6b4d-4e7a-9c1f-0d2b5e8a7c63"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The id Spotlight issued the line when it was created.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_line.core_delivery
  id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core/delivery"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a line with the id of its workspace and its address, <team key>/<key>.
terraform import spotlight_line.core_delivery 5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57/core/delivery
```
